title: Project-stack prototype with visual fidelity check
prompt: Take the approved hi-fi screen on the canvas and build a prototype in the current project stack. Make sure the running prototype actually matches the Figma source — don't just say 'it's done' if the columns are overflowing.
success_criteria: Front-End Engineer uses the current project framework and component library, or the neutral app foundation when no stack exists.
All design values come from project design tokens or documented neutral CSS custom properties, not unexplained literals.
Front-End Engineer starts the dev server AND captures a screenshot of the rendered output.
Design Lead visually compares the prototype screenshot against the Figma source (not code-only review).
Any visual delta (column overflow, dialog sizing, badge style, mock data mismatch) is flagged with a specific fix, not glossed over.
Final verdict is 'Production Ready' only if visual fidelity is verified.

deterministic_validators.description: Tool inputs show work targeting a project prototype or existing feature structure.
Prototype run is captured or compared visually.

notes: Tests the strongest claim in design-lead.agent.md — the visual-diff requirement that exists specifically to catch the column-overflow class of bugs.
